name: Chilion (Orpah's husband)
title: Moabite son-in-law
summary: Chilion was an Israelite from Bethlehem who, together with his family, moved to Moab during a famine. He married the Moabite woman Orpah but died childless in Moab after about ten years of marriage.

keyEvents.title: Emigration to Moab
keyEvents.description: Chilion traveled with his father Elimelech, mother Naomi, and brother Mahlon from Bethlehem to Moab due to a famine in Israel.

keyEvents.title: Death of the Father
keyEvents.description: Elimelech died in Moab, and Chilion and his brother remained with their mother Naomi.

keyEvents.title: Marriage to Orpah
keyEvents.description: Chilion married the Moabite woman Orpah, while his brother Mahlon married Ruth. They lived in Moab for about ten years.

keyEvents.title: Death of Chilion
keyEvents.description: Chilion died childless in Moab along with his brother Mahlon, leaving three widows: Naomi, Orpah, and Ruth.
